title: Final Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final expression for s_z(t).

title: Hamiltonian Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly derive the expression for d(s)/dt using the Hamiltonian.

title: Commutator Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly compute the commutator [s, H] and its implications.

title: Use of Cross Product
description: Important Criteria: The student should recognize and apply the cross product in the context of the magnetic field.

title: Initial Conditions
description: Optional Criteria: The student may specify initial conditions for s_z(0) and s_x(0) if relevant.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the equations derived.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
